generalAbilities.name: Motion Sense 60 feet
generalAbilities.description: A verdurous ooze can sense nearby creatures through vibration and air or water movement.

defensiveAbilities.name: Corrosive Surface
defensiveAbilities.description: A creature that hits a verdurous ooze with a metal weapon or unarmed attack must attempt a DC 21 Reflex Saving Throw save. On a failure, the weapon or creature takes 2d4 Acid Damage damage (after dealing damage to the ooze as normal). Thrown weapons take this damage automatically with no save.

defensiveAbilities.name: Enliven Foliage
defensiveAbilities.description: 20 feet. The verdurous ooze constantly emits supernatural vapors that cause nearby plants to grow rapidly and writhe and grasp at anything and everything within the emanation. This area becomes difficult terrain for non-verdurous ooze creatures. When a creature starts its turn in this aura, it must succeed at a DC 21 Reflex Saving Throw save or take a -10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds until it leaves the emanation.

defensiveAbilities.name: Split
defensiveAbilities.description: When a verdurous ooze that has 10 or more HP is hit by an attack that would deal piercing or slashing damage, it splits into two identical oozes, each with half the original's HP. One ooze is in the same space as the original, and the other is in an adjacent, unoccupied space. If no adjacent space is unoccupied, it automatically pushes creatures and objects out of the way to fill a space (the GM decides if an object or creature is too big or heavy to push).

The monster deals the listed amount of damage to any number of creatures Grabbed or Restrained by it. Each of those creatures can attempt a basic Fortitude save with the listed DC.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sleep Gas
offensiveAbilities.description:
The verdurous ooze adjusts its aura of supernatural vapors to affect living creatures within a 20ft Emanation, forcing them to attempt a DC 24 Will Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune to Sleep Gas for 24 hours.

Success The creature is Stupefied 1 for 1 round.

Failure The creature falls Unconscious. If it's still unconscious after 1 minute, it wakes up automatically.

Critical Failure The creature falls Unconscious. If it's still unconscious after 1 hour, it wakes up automatically.

offensiveAbilities.name: Verdurous Ooze Acid
offensiveAbilities.description: A verdurous ooze's acid damages only metal and flesh-not bone, stone, or other materials.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
